market_context: United States/general English; cooking beef, pork and other meat cuts from frozen
title: Can you cook meat directly from frozen?

seo.title: Can you cook meat directly from frozen?
seo.meta_description: Yes. USDA says meat can be cooked from frozen in the oven, on the stove or grill; it may take about 50% longer and internal temperature must be verified.
seo.search_intent: Learn when frozen meat can be cooked without thawing and how to adjust time and temperature.

excerpt: USDA says it is safe to cook meat directly from frozen in the oven, on the stove or grill. Cooking may take about 50% longer than thawed meat. Whole red-meat cuts still need 145 °F plus a 3-minute rest, while ground red meat needs 160 °F.
content_html:
Forgetting to thaw a steak does not always require a new dinner plan. USDA says frozen meat can be cooked safely in an oven, on the stove or on a grill when the proper internal temperature is reached.

Plan on about 50% more time

USDA's general estimate is roughly 1.5 times the cooking time of thawed or fresh meat. A roast that normally takes 60 minutes might approach 90, although size and method can change the result substantially.

Temperature depends on the product

ProductUSDA minimum
Beef, pork, lamb or veal steaks, chops and roasts145 °F + 3-minute rest
Ground beef, pork, lamb or veal160 °F
Poultry165 °F

The outside can brown while the center is still thawing, so a thermometer is particularly valuable.

Which shapes work best?

Individually frozen steaks and patties are easier to control than a solid block of several pieces. Separate stuck pieces as soon as they loosen enough.

Do not start raw frozen meat in a slow cooker

USDA advises against it because the meat can take too long to move through the bacterial danger zone.

Bottom line

Yes, meat can be cooked from frozen with relatively fast heat-transfer methods. Add about 50% more time as a starting estimate and verify internal temperature.

faq.question: How much longer does frozen meat take?
faq.answer: USDA estimates about 50% longer than thawed meat, though thickness and cooking method matter.

faq.question: Can I cook a roast from frozen?
faq.answer: Yes when the method cooks it evenly and the correct internal temperature is verified.

faq.question: Can frozen meat go into a slow cooker?
faq.answer: USDA advises against starting raw frozen meat in a slow cooker.
